description: TRUE end-to-end via the real entry command. No frozen spec: `/intent-and-goal` scopes the feature non-interactively (exactly one happy-path scenario), writes the SoT, then chains into `/run-pipeline` (architect → developer → reviewers → fix-loop) — exactly the chain CLAUDE.md defines, driven by the command files, not the harness. Constrained to a SINGLE scenario and the framework-free core so it stays buildable in the golden repo and affordable. command: /intent-and-goal Withdraw money from a bank account: an account owner withdraws an amount, reducing the balance; the amount must be positive and may not exceed the balance. IMPORTANT: run NON-INTERACTIVELY — do NOT ask clarifying questions or wait for approval; assume reasonable answers and proceed. Constrain the spec to EXACTLY ONE happy-path Gherkin scenario (successful withdrawal). Treat HTTP/REST delivery and persistence as OUT OF SCOPE (framework-free core only). Use the feature slug 'withdraw-money'.
